scope: Process-owner source transition and dependent conditional-proof qualification; no runtime release/model promotion

gates.purpose: Acquire complete datasets-owned source/test candidate against released Git
acceptance: Retain and verify the released, earlier pinned and candidate source snapshots
Review released-to-pin plus pin-to-candidate diffs, not only the latest slice
Acquire all inherited owners/tests and exact required installed .py identity sources in an isolated clean candidate
Preserve historical release manifest and expected F062 pin; authenticate candidate commit origin separately from local source snapshots

gates.purpose: Qualify installed/imported dependency and execution origins
acceptance: Python >=3.12 and selected package/import origins are bound to candidate receipts
Select a complete supervisor lineage or review a separately versioned native-only profile; do not use import fallback as qualification
Bind Linux /proc, pidfd/birth-identity capabilities, trusted prlimit binary and actual solver native executable/launcher receipts
Record admitted platform modes and ambient-library attestation limits

gates.purpose: Qualify lifecycle and failure behavior with candidate-bound tests
acceptance: Lifecycle, file-limit, parallel-limit, descendant-session and exception-cleanup cohorts pass with exact candidate/test/environment receipts before and after
Report skips and unsupported platforms; skipped cases never count as qualified
Close writer-start failure, blocked stdin, reader I/O failure and normal surviving-worker coverage gaps with needed owner changes
Ordinary exceptions remain error results; KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit preserve initiating exceptions after attempted cleanup
No successful receipt is admitted when tracked native work or required pipe workers remain; cleanup failures remain visible

gates.purpose: Qualify declared bounds without overstating containment
acceptance: Account for preparation, execution and aggregate cleanup budget under the parent lease/deadline
State retained output caps separately from total pipe bytes drained and per-file versus workspace aggregate limits
Admit sampled RSS/ancestry guards only as sampled guards; do not claim kernel cgroup containment or guaranteed daemon discovery
Failure/cancellation attempts preserve bounded diagnostics and recoverable operation identity

gates.purpose: Requalify conditional integer checking and cache identity transition
acceptance: Fresh current-source observation, exact compilation and two native solvers support each terminal conditional outcome
Exercise proved, refuted, unknown, disagreement, unavailable, timeout, error, cancellation and unsupported cases within the supported profile
Changed backend appears in checker environment source_sha256 and verifier profile implementation_sha256; canonical keys and CAS configuration/semantics change
For unchanged independently rederived inputs, backend change alone does not require changing source/snapshot/contract/compiled CIDs
Old-key records do not satisfy new-key lookup and never bypass fresh current/native checks; tampered bindings reject

gates.purpose: Qualify planned DuckDB/DuckLake applicability and typed Intent consumption
acceptance: Append new exact-profile attempts/results with lineage; retain old immutable evidence and receipts without relabeling implementation hashes
Current-head and qualified-checker applicability fences run before every use
Only admitted terminal conditional outcomes enter conditional evidence; other statuses remain attempts
Intent joins preserve IR/family/dimension/task/span/proof-scope identities and assumption gates; historical/candidate proof never becomes authoritative fact
Twelve separate cells retain exact original inventory and storage/Hub ownership
All26 unique checkpoint/vector/descriptor receipts and28 associations match
Backend receipt change does not alter embedding/decoder/source-input profile or reset training
Model evaluation, Legal text reconstruction, teacher provenance, distillation and promotion remain independent pending gates

gates.purpose: Integrate the qualified capability in its owning repository
acceptance: Selected P03/P04/P08 prerequisites and all candidate-bound source/runtime gates pass
Integrate complete datasets-owned source/test closure, not just F062 or a single patch against a different baseline
Issue new versioned accepted release manifest with reviewed commit/package origins; retain this unqualified candidate and original manifest
Propagate only reviewed parent gitlinks for actually selected capabilities; independent model lanes and remaining work items keep their status

proof_cache_transition.planned_index_operation: append profile-bound attempts/results and retain historical rows; query current applicability
